title: Fallen Angel Stock Watchlist
summary: Three watch-list businesses and an affiliated venture.
assessment: The clearest miss is the Sprouts bottom: later prices undercut February substantially. AWK subsequently appreciated, but the report remained a watch list and cannot claim an executed gain. Lululemon’s problems persisted. The Orange Juice section is an affiliated investment promotion with an unproven operating record, and is treated accordingly.

claims.reason: The claim ranks one cause as decisive without a probability model or identifiable counterfactual. Iranian choices, battlefield constraints and other governments also affect settlement; a final outcome cannot be attributed to U.S. politics alone.

coverage_note: Full numbered text and image inventory read. All material theses across macro, digital assets, investment analysis and concluding sections considered. Position listings and incidental descriptive statistics are excluded unless they support a thesis.
framework_lessons: Inspect liabilities and governance behind apparent cheapness.
verification_limitations: Current page snapshot is not an authenticated publication-date version.
A missing horizon is not replaced with an invented author deadline.
Market sensitivities use vendor adjusted closes and do not reconstruct portfolio execution.
The author discloses her general-partner role in the venture group launching Orange Juice. No private offering materials or audited venture returns were supplied.
